peckish: You could do with a bite to eat.
A faint emptiness in your belly reminds you it's been a while since you ate.
hungry: Your stomach growls. You haven't eaten in a while.
You're hungry; your thoughts keep drifting to food.
A hollow ache sits in your belly. You should eat something.
starving: Hunger gnaws at you. It's getting hard to think about anything else.
Your stomach cramps with hunger. You need to eat soon.
You're starving. The smell of anything cooking would make you weak at the knees.
ravenous: Your hands are shaking. You need food, now.
You're light-headed with hunger and your legs feel unsteady.
Hunger has become a pain. You can't go on like this much longer.
dying of hunger: You're dizzy and weak. If you don't eat soon, you'll collapse.
Black spots swim before your eyes. Your body is giving out for want of food.
You can barely stand. Without food you won't last much longer.

sleepy: A pleasant heaviness is creeping into your limbs.
tired: You're tired. A bed would be very welcome.
You catch yourself yawning again and again.
exhausted: Every step is an effort. You need to sleep.
You're exhausted; your thoughts are slow and muddled.
Your whole body aches with tiredness. You need rest.
collapsing: You can barely stay upright. Your body is going to give out.
Your eyes keep closing on their own. You'll drop where you stand if you don't sleep.
The world sways. You can't stay awake much longer.

hurting: Something aches. You're not quite whole.
You notice a dull pain that wasn't there before.
badly hurt: You're badly hurt. Every movement hurts.
Pain throbs through you. You need rest or care.
You're hurt worse than you'd like to admit.
critical: You're in a terrible state. You need help, or you won't make it.
Your strength is draining away. You need help, now.
Everything hurts and the edges of the world are going grey.
